newsitem.title: USA: Harold's Stores Q4 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Harold's Stores Q4 sales rise.

text.p: Harold's Stores Inc Friday reported higher sales for the fiscal fourth quarter and year ended February 1.
Sales in millions of dollars Percent change

Noting that its fourth quarter had 13 weeks compared to 14 in the prior year, and the year had 52 weeks compared to 53 in the previous year, Harold's said a "more accurate representation of comparable sales" would be to do the latest quarter with the corresponding 13 weeks and the latest year with the corrsponding 52 weeks a year earlier.
Sales in millions of dollars Percent change

The company reported catalog sales for the latest quarter of $2.9 million, down 3.5 percent from a year earlier, and $8.9 million for the year, down 5.3 percent. On a comparison of same-length periods, catalog sales were up 14.4 percent in the quarter and down 4.6 percent for the year.
